basis: Consolidated (Screener). Linde India has no subsidiary; consolidated = standalone plus equity-accounted share of two 50:50 joint ventures (Linde South Asia Services Pvt Ltd with Praxair India; Bellary Oxygen Company Pvt Ltd with INOX Air Products, being liquidated). Three renewable-power SPV 'associates' are carried at amortised cost, not equity-accounted. Fiscal year was January-December until CY2021; FY23 is a 15-month period (Jan-2022 to Mar-2023); April-March since.

profile.what: Industrial, medical and specialty gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, nitrous oxide, special gases) supplied through on-site plants and pipelines at customer sites, merchant liquid (bulk) deliveries and cylinders (packaged); and a Project Engineering Division (PED) that designs, builds and commissions air separation units (ASUs), nitrogen plants and pipelines for third parties and for its own gases business.
profile.scale: ~20,000 TPD installed capacity; 100+ ASUs and nitrogen plants built over 50 years; 12 ASU sites, 10 packaged-gas (PGP) sites, 1 debulking site, 2 engineering centres (Kolkata, Jamshedpur); 320+ distribution assets; annual power use 1,092,000 MU (22% renewable); 'owns & operates the highest number of ASUs on BOO basis in India'
profile.people: 252 permanent employees at Mar-2026 (operations and support staff largely sit in the LSAS joint venture with Praxair India); 800+ professionals serving gases and 300+ engineering professionals incl. contractual and LSAS staff
profile.asuSites: Taloja, Dahej, Sricity, ITC Bhadrachalam, JSL Jajpur, Tata Kalinganagar, SAIL Rourkela, Selaqui, Jamshedpur (1,290 tpd and 2,550 tpd), IGP Jamshedpur (500 tpd), Ludhiana

relatedParty.businessAllocation: JV & shareholders' agreement of 24-Mar-2020 with Praxair India (which also created the 50:50 LSAS services JV): new merchant business allocated by incumbency, else geography: Linde India takes East, North and West India (excluding industrial bulk in Maharashtra); Praxair India takes South and Central India and Maharashtra industrial bulk. Project engineering exclusively with Linde India; CO2, HyCO (hydrogen/carbon monoxide) and PST exclusively with Praxair India. New on-site business allocated on incumbency/technology/competitiveness; expansions and renewals stay with the incumbent.

regulatory.what: SEBI investigation: summons to the MD, Company Secretary and (Jan-2024) independent directors; writ petitions filed in Bombay High Court
SEBI interim ex-parte order; set aside by SAT on 22-May-2024 to allow inspection and reply

SEBI final order: RPT materiality must aggregate all transactions with a related party in a year; NSE to appoint a registered valuer to value the 'business foregone and received' under the business allocation; company to place the report before the Board and disclose a summary; role of directors/officers to be addressed separately
SAT dismissed Linde India's appeal; called the company's reading 'absurd' and the allocation a transfer of a 'profit making apparatus' 'without having received any compensation whatsoever'
Supreme Court admitted the company's appeal (filed 16-Dec-2025); no stay; SEBI to inform the court before acting on the valuation

NSE-appointed registered valuer's report (dated 16-Mar-2026) received with valuations of business 'allegedly foregone' and 'allegedly gained'; amounts not disclosed; company filed an IA in the Supreme Court on 1-Apr-2026 seeking no action on it
Further SEBI summons (9-Apr, 28-Apr, 11-Jun, 29-Jun, 7-Jul-2026), all answered; Supreme Court hearing listed 30-Jul, 5-Aug, 6-Aug-2026 but not taken up

history.event: Incorporated in Kolkata (CIN L40200WB1935PLC008184); 'over 90 years in India' as part of the BOC group (BOC India until Feb-2013)
Linde AG acquires BOC Group, the Indian company's parent
Over-leveraged years: loan funds Rs 1,445 cr (CY16, debt/equity 104%), PAT Rs 13-33 cr a year, ROE below 2%

Linde AG-Praxair merger creates Linde plc, which now owns 75% of Linde India and 100% of Praxair India; CCI makes approval conditional on Linde India selling its South Region business and its Bellary JV stake
Delisting attempt fails: floor price Rs 428.5, discovered price Rs 2,025; promoters reject it and the stock falls ~20%
South Region business (Bellary ASU, Hyderabad/Chennai cylinder stations, land) sold to Air Water India for Rs 1,380 cr; Rs 841 cr exceptional gain; debt repaid (D/E 5% at Dec-2019, nil from 2020)
JV & shareholders' agreement with Praxair India: 50:50 LSAS services JV and a business-allocation protocol by geography and product (see related parties)
Public shareholders reject the omnibus RPT resolution (93.94% of votes against)
Bellary Oxygen JV sells its 855 tpd ASU to JSW Steel; ~Rs 226 cr exceptional gain after tax; CY21 dividend Rs 13.5
Year-end moved to March: a 15-month FY23 (Jan-2022 to Mar-2023)

Growth capex resumes: Dahej 250 tpd merchant ASU (FY24), Ludhiana 250 tpd (FY25), Jamshedpur fabrication shop (Mar-2024), Tata Steel Kalinganagar 2 x 1,800 TPD de-captivation and Asian Paints Dahej contracts (FY25); cash falls from Rs 980 cr (Mar-24) to Rs 147 cr (Mar-25)
SEBI order (24-Jul-2024), SAT dismissal (5-Dec-2025), Supreme Court admits appeal without stay (16-Jan-2026), EGM defeat (5-Mar-2026), NSE valuer's report (16-Mar-2026)
JSL 1,450 tpd ASU and IOCL Panipat N2 plant capitalised; MD change (Jan-2026); three CFOs in 2026
